413:t_1:172.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「This is my great will... To make the great power of God known to the world, I hereby declare the beginning of a new holy war.」

413:t_1:173.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「We shall win, to bring absolute order to this planet and build a paradise filled with peace and glory upon it.」

413:t_1:174.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Follow me. That alone is the path to everlasting happiness.」

413:t_1:177.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「It's the other emissary from the heavens...!」

413:t_1:178.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... I believe I ordered you to assume combat readiness. What is the meaning of this foolish prank?」

413:t_1:179.en:
$$レド$$
「You're the one playing the fool.」

413:t_1:180.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I can't believe an Alliance warrior would say that.」

413:t_1:181.en:
$$レド$$
「This is Earth! It isn't the $$銀河同盟$$!」

413:t_1:182.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「But humans live on this planet. We bear responsibility for their future.」

413:t_1:183.en:
$$レド$$
「...The old me would have accepted your words without question.」

413:t_1:184.en:
$$レド$$
「But I've met many people on this planet and learned many things...」

413:t_1:185.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「What does that have to do with this...?」

413:t_1:186.en:
$$レド$$
「Responsibility?! No! The people who live on this planet have built their own world! We have no right to destroy it!」

413:t_1:187.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our justice has not changed. Don't hesitate.」

413:t_1:188.en:
$$レド$$
「I've said all I can... Come, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!!」

413:t_2:3.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Fleet Commander's Room～

413:t_2:4.en:
$$リジット$$
「...Can you hear me, everyone in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$? I am your Fleet Commander, $$リジット$$.」

413:t_2:5.en:
$$リジット$$
「As I've already informed you, $$レド$$, whom you all know, is fighting those targeting $$ガルガンティア$$ in the $$霧の海$$ right now.」

413:t_2:6.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$フェアロック$$ entrusted $$ガルガンティア$$ to me.」

413:t_2:7.en:
$$リジット$$
「Until the very end, our former Fleet Commander thought about this fleet's future. I want to live up to his wishes!」

413:t_2:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「I want to protect the $$ガルガンティア$$ he loved... this fleet that carries all your lives!」

413:t_2:9.en:
$$リジット$$
「...But I have no power alone. That's why I want you to lend me your strength!」

413:t_2:10.en:
$$リジット$$
「If you want to protect this fleet... $$ガルガンティア$$, the stronghold of our lives, please help me!」

413:t_2:11.en:
$$クラウン$$
「Can you hear them, $$リジット$$? Everyone is saying they'll help you.」

413:t_2:12.en:
$$オルダム$$
「That's how it should be, $$リジット$$. You, us, them... We are all members of this fleet.」

413:t_2:13.en:
$$リジット$$
「Thank you... Thank you, everyone!」

413:t_2:14.en:
$$リジット$$
「I will use $$ガルガンティア$$'s power, entrusted to me by our former Fleet Commander, here and now!」

413:t_2:18.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...I never knew something like this was hidden in $$ガルガンティア$$.」

413:t_2:19.en:
$$オルダム$$
「This is the great legacy handed down to our Fleet Commanders.」

413:t_2:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「This is what Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ entrusted to me...」

413:t_2:21.en:
$$オルダム$$
「They say this power was once used to restore the wounded Earth.」

413:t_2:22.en:
$$オルダム$$
「But I've heard it was also the power that destroyed the world. And it was entrusted to us... the $$船団五賢人$$.」

413:t_2:24.en:
$$オルダム$$
「You would awaken a weapon of a lost age once more... Are you prepared to violate that taboo, $$リジット$$... leader of $$ガルガンティア$$?」

413:t_2:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「I am. I have a duty to protect all the people who have gathered aboard this ship.」

413:t_2:26.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Then... use that power now.」

413:t_2:27.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$エイミー$$ will tell us the position...!」

413:t_2:28.en:
$$クラウン$$
「East 35, south 58... Target coordinate correction is complete!」

413:t_2:29.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Loading is complete. Begin spraying the water film for shock-wave interference.」

413:t_2:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「Activate the $$翠星蟲システム$$! Fire!!」

413:t_3:3.en: ～$$フロンティア船団$$　Chief Aide's Office～

413:t_3:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...We failed to destroy $c, but there's no need to hurry.」

413:t_3:5.en:
$$三島$$
「They can still be useful in keeping $$サイデリアル$$ in check.」

413:t_3:7.en:
$$三島$$
「Still, seeing you again like this is surprising. I thought you died in the $$再世戦争$$.」

413:t_3:8.en:
$$三島$$
「$$グレイス・オコナー$$... Or should I call you $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$?」

413:t_3:9.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Names don't matter. Nor do bodies...」

413:t_3:10.en:
$$三島$$
「That's right. To you people of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, a body is just a vessel.」

413:t_3:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The $$再世戦争$$ was a fine opportunity to gather data. Thanks to it, our $$バジュラ$$ research made tremendous progress...」

413:t_3:12.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「And we were able to test the results on another $$バジュラ$$ swarm we found in the galactic core.」

413:t_3:13.en:
$$三島$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s technology is remarkable... It controls the $$バジュラ$$ with $$インプラント$$ shells and $$フォールドジャミング$$.」

413:t_3:14.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That's also thanks to your sponsorship.」

413:t_3:15.en:
$$三島$$
「I'm not acting out of self-interest. I merely want to give up on the ever-troubled $$地球圏$$ and set off into the galaxy.」

413:t_3:16.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Analyzing the $$バジュラ$$'s biology also advanced our Fold technology at incredible speed.」

413:t_3:17.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「With enough energy, we can even Fold to the galactic core.」

413:t_3:18.en:
$$三島$$
「That's splendid. Accepting your proposal was worthwhile.」

413:t_3:19.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「You and I... No, $$ギャラクシー$$ and $$フロンティア$$ are partners, after all.」

413:t_3:20.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Now that we have the $$バジュラ$$'s power, $$サイデリアル$$ is the only obstacle left.」

413:t_3:21.en:
$$三島$$
「Heh... Once we eliminate them and control the $$女王バジュラ$$, ruling the galaxy won't be a pipe dream...」

413:t_3:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「To that end, I'd like to defeat $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, $$サイデリアル$$'s ruler, here on Earth.」

413:t_3:23.en:
$$三島$$
「In that case, $c could be useful...」

413:t_3:24.en:
$$三島$$
「I also have a personal grudge against their $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ members. Once $$サイデリアル$$ is dealt with, I'll crush them first.」

413:t_3:25.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(You never change, $$レオン・三島$$... I don't dislike that dreamy side of yours...)

413:t_3:26.en:
$$三島$$
「But is the matter of $$ブレラ・スターン$$ all right?」

413:t_3:27.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「There's no problem. An imperfectly controlled soldier is worthless.」

413:t_3:28.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Besides, I've obtained material to replace him.」

413:t_3:29.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(Hehe... If I analyze her, I'll gain even more fighting strength. Then our dear Chief Aide will have outlived his usefulness...)

413:t_3:33.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

413:t_3:35.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm sorry, $$エイミー$$. I've kept you worried all this time.」

413:t_3:36.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's okay... You've come back to me now.」

413:t_3:38.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Let's think about that together from now on.」

413:t_3:40.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You had reasons to do that. We had reasons to want you not to...」

413:t_3:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Instead of just pushing our own ideas through, let's consider each other's feelings and think together about what to do.」

413:t_3:42.en:
$$レド$$
「Am I... allowed to think, too?」
